construct: a TEXT-bearing part in an overlay anatomy whose box IS its own shrink-to-fit measurement — an inline-block beside a PINNED ancestor that moves (160px → 200px) without it
why: THE WALL PIN for the fill door. Its width is a function of the harness's sample text and font (the astryx.card 114.203px / 119.016px measurement of the SAME library version across a font swap), and its 20px height is its own line box, not the root's 24px content box. The ancestor MOVES here, so the case cannot pass by accident of a single observation: the fill test itself must fail. If a future widening of the text-fill door ever turns this case CARRIED, the gate goes red — the door can never become a blanket.

canvas.note: the canvas hugs, which is the honest outcome of an honest refusal
